clio.chart.v1.description: Any chart over tabular rows: a preset or an Altair/Vega-Lite spec.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Inline rows (at most 10000) — this array rides the surface's own wire message, so it is capped for transfer size; for a larger or growing dataset use dataUri instead, unbounded and paged/downsampled by the viewer. A cell is a scalar OR a strictly-shaped GeoJSON Geometry object ($defs/GeoJsonGeometry), so a geoshape mark can draw real shapes from inline rows.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation.

properties.name: selection
properties.description: Bind to /selection/<key>; the bound value is a SelectionState ({field, values[], source?}, see $defs/SelectionState). Components bound to the same path share one selection.

properties.name: selectionField
properties.description: Column used for an explicit selection binding. Ordinary views of one dataUri link by __row without this property; trajectory and spectra points select exact rows while entityField groups each curve.

properties.name: spec
properties.description: A Vega-Lite spec whose rows come from data/dataUri as the named dataset 'source' — the spec is chart configuration, never a data channel, and the dataset itself is unbounded via dataUri regardless of this cap. This schema already enforces the top-level key allowlist, no url/usermeta key at any depth, no bind.element at any depth (a CSS selector that could mount an input widget anywhere on the host page), and data only as {name: source} at any depth; the renderer additionally enforces the config-size (65536 bytes) and view-count (8) caps that keep the spec itself bounded and abuse-resistant, which JSON Schema cannot express. See a2ui/chart/guard_rules.json.

clio.data-table.v1.description: Tabular rows, inline or from a referenced dataset.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Required with inline rows; optional with dataUri (defaults to the queried/dataset columns).

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Inline rows; use dataUri instead for a registered dataset.

properties.name: selection
properties.description: Bind to /selection/<key>; the bound value is a SelectionState ({field, values[], source?}, see $defs/SelectionState). Components bound to the same path share one selection.

properties.name: selectionField
properties.description: Dataset column the shared selection's values are drawn from; required when selection is bound.

clio.map.v1.description: Interactive points, ordered trajectories, or GeoJSON geometry on a map.

properties.name: categoryField
properties.description: Dataset column grouping points into categories.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation. Requires latitudeField/longitudeField/labelField; a referenced dataset is bounded by dataQuery/limit, not the inline point cap.

properties.name: detailField
properties.description: Dataset column holding each point's detail text.

properties.name: filterFields
properties.description: With dataUri, columns worth filtering while exploring this map. Choose one or more real columns from the task and dataset, such as a category, magnitude, or time column. Use a registered table even for small maps when these native filters matter. The viewer creates typed controls and applies them to the map and Reference this; omit for the viewer's default fields.

properties.name: geojsonUri
properties.description: Artifact URI of a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Geometry is read by reference and drawn as points, lines, and polygons; feature properties supply labelField, categoryField, or valueField when named.

properties.name: idField
properties.description: Dataset column holding each point's stable id.

properties.name: labelField
properties.description: Dataset column holding each point's label (required with dataUri).

properties.name: latitudeField
properties.description: Dataset column holding latitude (required with dataUri).

properties.name: longitudeField
properties.description: Dataset column holding longitude (required with dataUri).

properties.name: orderField
properties.description: With trackField, time or numeric sequence column ordering positions along each trajectory.

properties.name: points
properties.description: Inline points (at most 500) — this array rides the surface's own wire message, so it is capped for transfer size; for a larger dataset use dataUri instead, unbounded and paged/downsampled by the viewer.

properties.name: selection
properties.description: Bind to /selection/<key>; the bound value is a SelectionState ({field, values[], source?}, see $defs/SelectionState). Components bound to the same path share one selection.

properties.name: selectionField
properties.description: Dataset column the shared selection's values are drawn from; required when selection is bound.

properties.name: trackField
properties.description: With dataUri, column identifying each trajectory (for example storm_id). Rows with the same value form one path.

properties.name: valueField
properties.description: Numeric dataset column used for a continuous colour scale and legend.

properties.name: valueLabel
properties.description: Human-readable name for the numeric map legend, such as Displacement.

properties.name: valueUnit
properties.description: Unit shown beside a continuous-colour legend's values.

clio.raster-viewport.v1.description: An interactive viewport for a registered two-dimensional grid, with sampled values, colour scale, and region reference.

clio.mesh-viewport.v1.description: An orbitable 3D view of a registered standard mesh or a CLIO FEA mesh with optional result fields.

properties.name: camera
properties.description: Camera position, target, and orientation. Bind it to a data path to retain or coordinate the view.

properties.name: field
properties.description: Name of the scalar result field to color by, as stored in the CLIO FEA mesh.

properties.name: format
properties.description: The mesh file format. Set it when the file bytes do not identify the format unambiguously.

properties.name: frame
properties.description: Zero-based result frame. Bind it to a slider value to step through a simulation.

properties.name: materialUri
properties.description: Registered MTL companion file for an OBJ model.

properties.name: meshUri
properties.description: Reference to a registered mesh artifact, such as artifact://artifact_specimen. The viewer loads the model from that artifact.

properties.name: showField
properties.description: Show or hide scalar coloring while keeping the geometry visible.

properties.name: syncGroup
properties.description: Matching group names link the cameras and color scales of related 3D viewports.

properties.name: thresholdField
properties.description: Result field used to keep only geometry within a chosen value interval.

properties.name: thresholdMax
properties.description: Upper bound of the visible field interval. It can read a value from a control.

properties.name: thresholdMin
properties.description: Lower bound of the visible field interval. It can read a value from a control.

properties.name: title
properties.description: A short, descriptive title for the view.

properties.name: upAxis
properties.description: The axis treated as vertical when framing and orbiting the model.

clio.weather.v1.description: Current weather and hourly or daily forecasts for a field site or location.

properties.name: observedAt
properties.description: ISO 8601 local date-time with an explicit UTC offset or Z.

clio.message-draft.v1.description: Editable alternatives for an email, chat message, or text, with copy and open actions.

clio.steps.v1.description: An interactive protocol or recipe with checkable actions, timers, and separately scaled ingredients.

clio.action-card.v1.description: A short pitch with up to six labeled actions.

clio.approval.v1.description: A gated decision with one to four actions.

clio.workflow.v1.description: A step/edge graph showing a multi-step plan's progress.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation. A JSON file shaped {"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]}.

properties.name: edges
properties.description: Inline edges (at most 256), alongside nodes.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: Inline nodes (at most 128) — rides the surface's own wire message; give edges too, or use dataUri instead of both for a larger graph, unbounded.

clio.metric.v1.description: One labeled number, optionally with a unit and trend.

clio.status.v1.description: A single labeled state, e.g. a running step.

clio.progress.v1.description: A bounded or indeterminate operation's progress.

clio.callout.v1.description: A short flagged note distinct from plain text (info/warning/error severity).

clio.artifact.v1.description: A reference card for one registered artifact.

clio.code.v1.description: Syntax-highlighted source, inline or from a referenced file.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Inline source; use dataUri instead for a referenced file.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation. Its file content is the source.

clio.diff.v1.description: A unified diff for one path, inline or from a referenced file.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation. Its file content is the diff text.

properties.name: diff
properties.description: Inline unified diff text; use dataUri instead for a referenced file.

clio.mermaid.v1.description: A declarative Mermaid diagram, inline source or from a referenced file.

properties.name: dataUri
properties.description: A workspace file path or artifact:// reference; CLIO registers a path as an artifact before validation. Its file content is the source.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Inline diagram source; use dataUri instead for a referenced file.

Button.description: A clickable control wrapping one child, firing an action.

ChoicePicker.description: A single- or multiple-selection picker; bind value to the path an action reads.

DateTimeInput.description: A date, time, or date-time input with an ISO 8601 value; enable the needed parts.

Slider.description: A whole-number range control (see clio.slider.v1 for fractional steps).

TextField.description: A single- or multi-line text input.

clio.slider.v1.description: A fractional-step numeric control, or a two-value range, with typed value boxes.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Describe the quantity the person is changing.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Largest allowed value.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Smallest allowed value.

properties.name: range
properties.description: Enable two handles for an interval instead of one value.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Distance between allowed values, including fractional increments.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Short unit shown beside the value, such as s or mm.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current numeric value, or two bounds in range mode. A bound data path lets other components read the same value.

Column.description: A vertical layout container for child components.

Divider.description: A horizontal or vertical rule separating layout regions.

Frame.description: A titled container around one child component.

Grid.description: A fixed-column grid layout container for child components.

Icon.description: A named or SVG icon glyph.

Image.description: A raster or vector image by URL, sized to a preset variant.

List.description: A vertical or horizontal list of child components, optionally templated from bound data.

Modal.description: A dialog opened by a trigger component, showing one content component.

Row.description: A horizontal layout container for child components.

Tabs.description: A tabbed switcher between named child components.

Text.description: A run of text, plain or headed (h1-h5, caption, body).
